title: the verify is thirty eight thousand nanoseconds not one — a machine-checked theorem of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit

nsPerVerify = 38000 ∧ nsPerVerify > 1 ∧ nsPerVerify > 10000

\mathrm{nsPerVerify} = 38000 \land \mathrm{nsPerVerify} > 1 \land \mathrm{nsPerVerify} > 10000
